summary: The single-process CSR setup covers nItems nonzeros over all rows. The runtime-count loop repeatedly launches the scalar-per-row kernel; each valid launched row scans from rowDelimiters[row] to rowDelimiters[row+1], accumulates every stored entry and writes its output. The compiled timed loop contains the iteration backedge, actual cudaLaunchKernel call and synchronization before timer end. The CMake target and available native dump include sm_86.
